assets.title: Week 14 model mini design board
assets.description: A model mini design board with visible student-friendly section labels and short readable text aligned to the Week 14 reading and listening tasks.
assets.notes: Keep the section labels and text readable on a phone screen. The model board must visibly support opener answers and align exactly with the reading text and the listening script.

assets.title: Week 14 cumulative review board
assets.description: A keyed cumulative review board for garment, part, fabric, detail, and inspiration review with visible clues that support app-checked matching.
assets.notes: Keep all visual clues visible and stable. The board should support literal key matching and simple category recognition without hidden logic.

assets.title: Week 14 reusable four-panel gallery image A to image D
assets.description: A reusable four-panel gallery labeled only image A, image B, image C, and image D for label matching, structured drafting, final submission, and the teacher presentation session.
assets.notes: Keep the literal image A to image D labels visible and stable. Each panel should show one distinct adult-oriented fashion look with clear garment, fabric, detail, and inspiration cues so the selected image key can be reused meaningfully.

assets.title: Week 14 model mini-board presentation
assets.description: One short slow clear model presentation aligned exactly to the Week 14 model mini design board.
assets.notes: Keep the full script only in audio_prompts.json. Do not create a separate transcript asset. The script, model board, question labels, options, and correct answers must match exactly.
